note: C00-12: every threshold here has an approver and a source. A number with neither is a guess that happens to be written down, and perf_gate::validate refuses it.

budgets.workload: P0 startup: kroma acp initialize to first response
budgets.measurement_method: spawn kroma acp, send initialize, measure wall clock to the first response line; process tree PSS sampled every 100 ms
budgets.sample_plan: 5 alternating runs per exposure, median reported, spread reported as basis points
budgets.noise_basis: E01 measured a 324 KB between-arm spread against an 8 027 KB within-arm spread; anything inside the within-arm spread is noise
budgets.approved_by: owner (2026-10-19, owner-authorized unlimited gemini-3.8-flash for experiment spend; performance thresholds approved in the same session)

budgets.workload: P1 idle: a session that has initialized and does nothing
budgets.measurement_method: cpu ticks (utime+stime) of the whole process tree over 8 idle seconds after initialize
budgets.noise_basis: E01 measured 0 ticks for both exposures; the ceiling is 1 tick so that a single scheduler tick is allowed and two are a regression

budgets.workload: P2 activation: first token latency with the full tool schema
budgets.measurement_method: provider-reported TTFT mean per arm over the frozen dev suite
budgets.sample_plan: 6 tasks per arm, one repetition; spread across the arm's own samples decides INCONCLUSIVE
budgets.noise_basis: E01: 14 040 ms full schema vs 3 568 ms minimal, a 4x gap far outside the arm spread; smaller gaps are not claimed
